PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[Rebel Infantry (Errata 3)]], front face. It prints the PC-E3 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the release-sheet text of [[Rebel Infantry]] (original). The Master List slip prints no slip number, only the E mark at the bottom right.

== References ==
[https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)], PDF page 27. Wiki copy: [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]].

Rendered at 300 dpi from the PDF and cropped to the slip (11 November 2026, Batch R8-U).
